specs.Battery: Equipped with a rechargeable battery, the Maizic Smarthome PS4 Wireless Controller offers up to 10 hours of continuous gaming on a full charge.
specs.Buttons: Features 4 action buttons, dual analog sticks, a D-pad, and motion-sensitive controls. The DualShock vibration feedback provides an immersive gaming experience.
specs.Compatible Android Games: Limited Support – may connect via Bluetooth to some Android devices, but not officially optimized for Android gaming.
specs.Compatible IOS Games: Limited Support – may connect via Bluetooth to select iOS devices, but not officially designed for iOS gaming.
specs.Compatible Windows Games: Not Applicable – this controller is built for PS4. Can work on PC only with third-party adapters/software.
specs.OS Supported: The Maizic Smarthome PS4 Wireless Controller is compatible with PlayStation 4, Windows PC, and Android devices. It does not support iOS or other platforms.
specs.Type: The Maizic Smarthome PS4 Wireless Controller connects wirelessly via Bluetooth, ensuring a lag-free and seamless gaming experience on PlayStation 4 consoles.
